metadata.description: Deploys the ExtraHop data connector for Microsoft Sentinel as an Azure Function App, along with its supporting resources (Data Collection Endpoint/Rule, Log Analytics table, Application Insights, and storage account). Choose HostingPlanType (FlexConsumption/LinuxConsumption) and StorageAccountAccessType (Public/Private - Private is only supported with FlexConsumption, for regional VNet integration). For Private storage, choose NetworkDeploymentMode: New has this template create its own VNet, subnets, and private DNS zones automatically; Existing lets you supply your own subnet and private DNS zone resource IDs (including cross-subscription/cross-resource-group DNS zones, e.g. a centrally managed hub). All four storage private endpoints (blob/file/queue/table) are created for Private storage, since the Durable Functions Azure Storage provider used by this connector's orchestrator requires access to all four. For FlexConsumption, function code deployment is fully automated via an in-template deploymentScripts resource (DeployPackage), which retries the zip-deploy step up to 8 times with a 300s per-attempt timeout and 30s backoff to allow for RBAC/DNS propagation, and explicitly depends on the storage RBAC role assignment and blob private endpoint/DNS zone group completing first. LinuxConsumption self-deploys via WEBSITE_RUN_FROM_PACKAGE and needs no separate deploy step. The outbound Network Security Group (New VNet mode) allows outbound HTTPS (443) to the 'Internet' service tag, which is required for the Function App's platform self-calls and build-tooling dependencies to succeed when VNet-integrated.

dataFlows.transformKql:
source
| extend TimeGenerated = todatetime(now()), json_src = parse_json(src), json_dst = parse_json(dst), json_properties = parse_json(properties)
| extend json_src_device = parse_json(json_src.device), json_dst_device = parse_json(json_dst.device)
| extend src_type = tostring(json_src.type), src_hostname = tostring(json_src.hostname), src_ipaddr = tostring(json_src.ipaddr), src_role = tostring(json_src.role), src_endpoint = tostring(json_src.endpoint), src_external = tobool(json_src.external), src_device_oid = toreal(json_src_device.oid), src_device_name = tostring(json_src_device.name), src_device_ipaddrs = todynamic(json_src_device.ipaddrs), src_device_macaddr = tostring(json_src_device.macaddr), src_device_role = tostring(json_src_device.role), src_username = tostring(json_src.username), dst_type = tostring(json_dst.type), dst_hostname = tostring(json_dst.hostname), dst_ipaddr = tostring(json_dst.ipaddr), dst_role = tostring(json_dst.role), dst_endpoint = tostring(json_dst.endpoint), dst_external = tobool(json_dst.external), dst_device_oid = toreal(json_dst_device.oid), dst_device_name = tostring(json_dst_device.name), dst_device_ipaddrs = todynamic(json_dst_device.ipaddrs), dst_device_macaddr = tostring(json_dst_device.macaddr), dst_device_role = tostring(json_dst_device.role), dst_username = tostring(json_dst.username), properties_randomness = toreal(json_properties.randomness) ,properties_client_port = toreal(json_properties.client_port), properties_server_port = toreal(json_properties.server_port), properties_user = tostring(json_properties.user), properties_command = tostring(json_properties.command)
| project-away json_src, src, json_src_device, src_device, json_dst, dst, json_dst_device, dst_device, json_properties, properties 
| project-rename DetectionType = ['type'], DetectionTitle = ['title'], timestamp = ['time']
